detail.longDescription: Microsoft Warns: AI Accelerating Discovery of Software Issues Could Lead to More Outages Due to Hasty Fixes # software # artificialintelligence AI is speeding up the discovery of software vulnerabilities—but rushed fixes, especially on legacy systems, could trigger outages.
